name: Server-side template evaluation behind a confirmed hidden parameter

then.hypothesis: Ask the confirmed hidden parameter one question: did the server EVALUATE a template expression? The payload is an arithmetic sentinel (1337*1337, percent-encoded because curl does not encode a query for us) and the only oracle is the exact product 1787569 in the response body -- a bare 49 occurs in benign markup and an echoed expression only proves the request arrived, so neither is a hit. The has_param gate guarantees a query string, so the parameter is appended with & and rendered through hyp.param; obs_url carries the same value so the minted finding has a url the OOB validator can re-send through.
